Title: First email
Prompt: Write the first email. Include the steps I list and the support address I give. Do not welcome them for a page. Do not promise a call I did not offer.

Title: Stuck
Use when: They have not finished step two.
Prompt: Write a short email that names step two and the likely blocker I described. One link.

Title: Done
Prompt: Write the email that says what they can do next, from my list. Do not upsell a product I did not name.

Title: Subject lines
Prompt: Write six subject lines that state the action. No fake 're:'.

Title: Plain text
Use when: The mail should work without images.
Prompt: Rewrite the email as plain text. Keep the links visible.

Title: Consent
Prompt: Say whether this email is about the thing they just bought. If I am mixing in news, separate it and say it needs consent.
Check: Marketing is not hidden in the receipt.
